lines.say: Do carbs at night make you fat?
Your body doesn't watch the clock. Fat gain comes from eating more energy than you burn, over days and weeks.
In one study, people who ate most of their carbs at dinner lost slightly more weight than those who spread them out, and felt less hungry.
Late-night snacking is the real problem. It's usually extra food, on top of a full day.
For lifters, carbs at night can even help refill your muscles for the next workout.
Verdict: myth. Total food per day matters far more than the time.
If late eating gives you heartburn, eat two or three hours before bed.
